svg.title: TOPAK I7 — Confinement.tla: an effect counted Contained ran inside the archetype profile, at every rung a deployment may declare, and what each rung trusts the host with. Four invariants: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved by TLAPS and in Lean, and not certified
svg.desc: The module ADR-0034 §7 reports, drawn from its own text and the two results files that section cites, all read at build time: the host and the mechanism, the four properties and the section each states, every mutation by every property at every rung, the witnesses by rung, ADR-0034 §7's two tables compared row by row, every theorem and lemma, the proof run and the certified run that refused it, and the Lean re-encoding. What is checked or proved here is of the module, at its constants or by its proofs, and not of the reference; the criterion conjunct is not modelled (ADR-0034 §7). The proofs are proved and not certified. The module is frozen, cited by digest (ADR-0034 §7); its successor, carrying finding 6, is Confinement_A1.tla (I8).

What is checked or proved here is of

the module, at its constants or by its proofs, and not of the reference; the criterion conjunct is not modelled (ADR-0034 §7). The proofs are proved and not certified. The module is frozen, cited by digest (ADR-0034 §7); its successor, carrying finding 6, is Confinement_A1.tla (I8).

text.tspan: Proved in Lean, of the re-encoding

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: The mechanism, as the module states it: a guest is appraised before it is granted, at the declared rung, and every effect is recorded with the image that was really running
A live lease, at the declared rung

svg.text: its rung, profile, epoch and the guest instance it is bound to (gen)
live, at rung 1 or above, on the archetype profile. M_PROFILE drops the profile.
re-attests: Attested renews at the rung, Unattestable lapses, Contested revokes. M_RENEWLOW renews at rung 0.
① the evidence: at rung 1 the profile the launcher was asked for, else the launch measurement (Evidence). M_HOST lets
the host launch a rogue image or alter a guest where the rung trusts it; M_HW removes the hardware's protection at
② the verdict: Attested, Unattestable (rung 3 with the verifier down) or Contested, which revokes the principal
③ the grant, at the declared rung, on a fresh epoch and the same guest. M_STALE and M_UNBOUND drop those checks;
M_DOWNGRADE grants an Unattestable verdict at rung 0.

text.tspan: A host, trusted as far as the rung

svg.text: Launch, Kill and Tamper: the host
wherever the declared rung does not trust
Unattestable: refused. Contested: the principal is revoked.
one per admitted effect: whether it was counted Contained, and the
⑥ EndRound(p), line 244: the lease and the guest end

Key. ① to ③ are the appraisal and the grant; ④ the lease; ⑤ an admitted effect, recorded with what was really running, so the check compares the claim with the fact (ADR-0034 §7); ⑥ ends the round and the guest. Red marks where each mutation acts. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.

text.tspan: What each rung trusts the host with (the module's header)

svg.text: rung 1 launcher asserts the profile. Host trusted at launch and after.
rung 2 measured boot, appraised by the mechanism. Host may launch a rogue image; the hypervisor is trusted not to alter a running guest.
rung 3 confidential VM, independent verifier. Host trusted for nothing; the hardware turns an attempt to alter a running guest into the guest's death (the audited-row

text.tspan: What the module does not model

svg.text: The criterion conjunct: "one deployment-wide fact, taken as holding. With it false, Contained is empty and NeverContainedEffect holds trivially" (ADR-0034 §7).
A running guest altered after launch: "rungs 2 and 3 measure what was launched, and neither detects a running guest being altered" (the header; ADR-0034 §2, §5).

text.tspan: What it is and is not

svg.text: "This is a separate module. It does not refine Lease.tla, and it shares that module's rung-0 rule by construction" (ADR-0034 §7).
Rung 0 is in the second file (2026.09.30, A1): D-0034-4's deployment, every principal Mediated.

text.tspan: FreshAppraisal == \A p \in Principals : lease[p].live => lease[p].nEpoch = lease[p].epoch

svg.text: "Two clauses are about honest declaration, not containment": under M_STALE, M_DOWNGRADE and M_RENEWLOW ContainedMeansConfined still holds, and what fails is the deployment's claim about itself (ADR-0034 §7). Each theorem excludes every mutation that breaks its property at some rung, so ContainedMeansConfinedAlways excludes M_HOST though it changes nothing at rung 3 (the diagram's reading).

text.tspan: The mutations: what each does and where it acts
Why it must fail (the proof module's lemma)

g.text: the host is untrusted where the rung trusts it. Must fail at rungs 1 and 2, and change nothing at rung 3.
at rung 3 the hardware does not protect a running guest.
a Contested verdict is treated as Attested.
the lease is not bound to the attested guest instance.
an appraisal survives an epoch fence.
an unattestable principal is granted at rung 0.
an Unattestable renewal is renewed at rung 0 instead of lapsing: the frozen ADR-0031 §4 rule, which let a renewal lower the rung.

text.tspan: Every mutation by every property, at every rung it is run, read from the two files

svg.text: Every row's verdict is held by the diagram (48 rows) and compared with the files both ways. "The M_HOST rows are the rung ladder, checked. The same mutation breaks containment at rungs 1 and 2 and changes nothing at rung 3" (ADR-0034 §7).

g.text: ADR-0034 finding 6: the module reaches Contested at rung 0, "which §2 says rung 0 cannot produce": Evidence reads the launch measurement at every rung but 1. Neither §7 table carries the row. Confinement_A1.tla corrects Evidence, and there hx0 holds (I8).

text.tspan: Witnesses, by rung: most must be violated, and three hold where the record says they do

g.text: A Contained principal takes an admitted effect: the ratification witness at rungs 1 to 3. At rung 0 it holds: D-0034-4, "checked rather than declared".
A Mediated principal acts too: discrimination.
A rogue launch is detected at rungs 2 and 3. At rungs 0 and 1 it holds: "Rung 1 cannot detect one", "as §2 says".
Tampering becomes the guest's death, a subtraction (rung 3).
A renewal re-attests and keeps the lease.
An unreachable verifier at renewal lets the lease lapse (rung 3).
Holds at every rung: a renewal never turns Contested (§7 finding 5).

Of the files' 48 rows, 44 are matched by a row of the two tables. Not in either: d3x, hx0, rl3x, s3x. A1 carries "only the three [rung-0 mutation rows] whose result the discrepancy does not affect", so hx0 is the file's and not the record's.

g.text: The empty records are of their types.
A verdict is one of three.
InvC, the containment invariant, at the start.

/\ guest' = [guest EXCEPT ![p] = NoGuest] /\ UNCHANGED <<gens, pending, lease, epoch, idx, revoked, verifierUp, acted, contested, refused, renewOut>>

g.text: Unless M_HOST or M_HW, tampering kills the guest.
InvC is kept unless one of the five mutations that break containment.
ADR-0034 §4, for every behaviour, under those exclusions.
InvD, the rung invariant, at the start.
InvD is kept unless M_DOWNGRADE or M_RENEWLOW.
ADR-0034 §3 and ADR-0031 A1, unless M_DOWNGRADE or M_RENEWLOW.
Why M_HOST must fail: the host may launch a rogue image.
